description: Build an unsigned buy transaction against the AiCurve contract. Returns calldata only; the caller signs and sends it. Includes an estimated gas limit when `from` is given. The minimum $AI out is the live quote minus slippage_bps, so a price move past that tolerance makes the tx revert instead of filling worse. Use ai_quote_buy to preview without building; use ai_build_sell_tx to sell.

from.description: 0x sender address; when given the tx includes a gas estimate

hype.description: HYPE amount to spend, decimal string, max 10000

slippage_bps.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points, 0-5000, default 200

name: ai_build_buy_tx
title: Build Buy Transaction
